_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Mathematics Standard (041), Series C4ABD/4, SET-1. 23 pages (cover says 23 printed pages; last folio 'Page 23'): idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-22, Hindi on every odd index 1-21 (each odd page is the Hindi of the page after it). The top of every odd page was checked and opens with Hindi; the last page (idx 22) is English (Q38). No parity inversion. The watermark-repaired renders are clean: no black bars over text on any English page. Instruction (vii)/(viii) prints the internal-choice count: 2 in B, 2 in C, 2 in D and 3 in E (the 2-mark part of each case study) = 9 alternatives, all found: Q22, Q23, Q27, Q29, Q33, Q34, Q36, Q37, Q38; the marking scheme walk confirms exactly these nine OR blocks. Section-A keys read off the marking scheme for 30/4/1 (read as images) and each re-derived: all 20 agree; no void notes anywhere in the scheme. Decimal points are RAISED on this paper (Q13, Q18, Q25, Q32), written {\cdot}. Section E prints 'Case Study – 1/2/3' headings, kept in _caseStudyLabel only. Case-study parts print (i), (ii)(a) OR (ii)(b), (iii), so refs are Q36i, Q36iia, Q36iib, Q36iii. Opener of series 30/4: nothing skipped.

options.label: B

options.label: C
options.text: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.

options.label: D
